risks: Root-owned uncommitted wave0 changes may invalidate line ranges and hashes after this inspection; accepted dependency receipts are still required even when related code exists.

Normative product baseline e953786 differs from dispatch input a21aeab and actual working-tree content; lead must approve the committed implementation generation rather than worker checking out or overwriting root changes.
Current pending operation memory replay can be mistaken for crash recovery; it does not survive renderer/process exit.
Native engine FNV/length hash is not canonical SHA-256 revision; derived unmarked block IDs change on edits and whole-document stamping can change frontmatter/CRLF and nonedited bytes.
Revoke handling that only blocks save or updates capabilities can leave protected content, task projections, comparison or unrestricted copy visible; cached old grants cannot authorize replay.
A fresh policy check outside the commit lock has a revoke race; replay authorization must share the accepted canonical authority fence.
Automatic merge of every structural/text race is not guaranteed; explicit conflict is required instead of destructive guessed reparent or node resurrection.

New files plus two shared patches do not authorize RPC/preload/localization/cache-owner rewrites. Missing integration must be supplied by accepted dependencies or a revised reviewed packet, not hidden incomplete functionality.
Provider queued receipt, mock persistence, isolated fixture UI, a toast or source/schema validation cannot discharge native restart/network/collaboration/ACL/UI acceptance.
Offline remote-private access requires explicit bounded lease; immediate revocation of a disconnected device and recall of exported copies cannot be promised.
